Name: Stack To Nearby Casks
Author: stebaker92
Description:
[size=5][b]Stack To Nearby Casks[/b][/size]

This mod simply adds a "Stack To Nearby Casks" button in your inventory, which moves items (i.e. cheeses & wines) into nearby casks

My first mod, originally built for If you've built a cellar or a farm full of casks, 

[heading]Features[/heading]
Clicking the stack button will fill every empty cask nearby:
[list]
[*]Open your inventory[/*]
[*]Click the stack button in the corner (above the organize button)[/*]
[*]Every empty cask within range gets filled with your configured item[/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley:[/b] 1.6 Compatible[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI:[/b] 4.3.2+[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer?[/b] Untested in multiplayer but should work for for players with the mod installed [/*]
[*][b]Other Mods:[/b] No known conflicts.[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Translations[/size][/b]
None yet! 
Translations welcome, validate at [url=smapi.io/json/i18n]smapi.io/json/i18n [/url]and send it via Nexus message or comments. credit given.
